Numeric references in the C1 range use the WHATWG replacement table

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<p>Single: &#155; Euro: &#128; Bullet: &#149; Y: &#159;</p>", options = ConversionOptions$default())

```
